method: Horse-by-horse pre-release Melbourne Cup handicap estimate for all 101 original nominees. Uses exposed class, Group/Grade record, staying evidence, Australian handicap history, age/sex context, Cup-distance performance, current preparation and handicap compression. Northern Hemisphere three-year-olds are handled on a separate age-adjusted scale. Estimates are not official weights.

rules.topweightAnchorRationale: Provisional scale anchor only; required so the working declaration respects the 59kg minimum topweight rule.

predictions.reason: Multiple Group 1-winning mare; elite merit but mare treatment and Cup history keep her below the topweight anchor.

integrityNotes: All 101 official 1 September nominees are represented.
Sir Delius remains excluded because he is not in the official 101.
Constitution Hill is retained only because he was an original nominee; his first-ballot qualification failed and he is not treated as an active Cup contender.
Whisky On The Hill and Daiquiri Bay remain qualification-tracker horses only unless a valid late nomination is confirmed.
Predictions freeze at 23:59 Melbourne time on 16 September before official weights are declared on 17 September.
